note: Replay goldens of std-lolo-rust (std-lolo-source with the Rust vocabulary). Each case feeds the program and the checker's types (program/read with inspect, the types map read by ir-path) as the LOLO_INSPECTED answer (program/read has no substrate host in goldens, G-STD-262), with the installed operator names seeded in the entity. The program is the one of the Python case of the same id, so every case keeps its paired control. 118 operators of the pure categories (str, array, object, math, validate, json, arithmetic, comparison, logic, control) have a template. The 72 with no Rust template render as a warning and a panicking stub: array/cosine, array/groupBy, array/nearest, array/partition, array/pmap, array/preduce, array/shuffle, bit/and, bit/not, bit/or, bit/rotl, bit/rotr, bit/shl, bit/shr, bit/xor, json/nodes, json/parse, json/stringify, json/valid, math/random, math/randomInt, object/clone, object/deepClone, object/deepMerge, object/entries, object/equals, object/filter, object/fromEntries, object/keys, object/mapKeys, object/mapValues, object/set, object/values, path, quasiquote, quote, row/matches, str/camelCase, str/collate, str/collate-key, str/decode-uri-component, str/encode-uri-component, str/kebabCase, str/replace-pattern, str/snakeCase, str/template, str/titleCase, str/to-number, str/uri-component-valid, tree/fold, tree/index, unquote, validate/array, validate/boolean, validate/check, validate/creditCard, validate/date, validate/email, validate/length, validate/maxLength, validate/minLength, validate/noneOf, validate/number, validate/object, validate/pattern, validate/phone, validate/required, validate/string, validate/url, validate/uuid, value/depth, value/key. Number literals are written as f64 (numberIntForm and numberForm are {{json}}_f64). The recorded texts compile against the models the Rust shell generates and give the kernel's answers, checked by the standalone crate of the report.
